_note: Map completion gifts (owner decision 11, 2026-11-26). The wiki's Map completion page: each map below gives its gift on map completion, once per character (map completion is per character), so a player can repeat it on another character. The wiki's 'Rewarded by: Map completion' rows (one generic page for every map) are dropped: they made one activity that gave all nineteen gifts at once. Gift of Inner Nayos is not a completion reward (achievements). The Path of Fire gifts (Oasis, Highlands, Riverlands, Desolation) are not a completion reward: map completion only lets the character buy them (their vendor sources stay). minutes: owner's estimate for one map completion on one character (2026-11-26: 60 min per map); DRF refines it. map_id: official API map id (Verdant Brink has two map ids; 1052 is the open world one).
_lanterns_note: Illuminating <map> lantern achievements (owner 2026-11-27, SPEC §6.7 'Map completion, then the repeatable'): repeatable achievements; each completion gives a Chest of the Obscure, which holds that map's gift (wiki 'Contained in': guaranteed, quantity 1). lantern_minutes: owner's estimate for one run (25 min); DRF refines it. after: the map whose completion activity opens the repeatable (the plan completes that map once, first, then repeats the lanterns; pack after_activity). Inner Nayos has none: the Gift of Inner Nayos is not a map completion reward (its other sources are the one-off Inner Nayos Mastery II and Secrets of the Obscure: The Realm of Dreams Mastery achievements and Gharr Leadclaw's vendor, which itself requires Illuminating Inner Nayos), so its lanterns are open from the start. Inner Nayos lanterns are in Heitor's Territory and Nyedra Surrounds, both on map 1526.
